name: [AddonRepo] Deployment and testing documentation for partners
description:
## Summary

There is no partner-facing documentation for the addon repository, so a partner cannot test an addon safely or deploy it without asking a Shoptet engineer. That makes every onboarding and every non-obvious deployment a support interaction, and it is the reason mistakes reach production e-shops instead of being caught by the partner. This task documents the deployment flow end to end for a partner audience: how to connect a repository, how to test an addon before publishing, what the pipeline validates and what it does not, how to read a failed deployment, and how to roll back. It also documents the same flow for internal use, so anyone on duty can reproduce a partner's problem without reverse-engineering the pipeline. Documentation should be written against the migrated pipeline to avoid documenting a setup that is about to be retired.

## Why?

Every partner deployment that is not routine currently needs a Shoptet engineer. That is a support cost on us and a delay for the partner, and without a documented way to test before publishing, partner mistakes land on live storefronts.

## What?

A partner can connect a repository, test an addon before publishing, deploy it, diagnose a failure and roll back, using documentation alone. Someone on internal duty can follow the same documentation to reproduce a partner's problem.

## Acceptance Criteria

Documented: connecting a repository and the requirements it must satisfy

Documented: how to test an addon before it is published to live e-shops

Documented: what the pipeline validates and, explicitly, what it does not

Documented: how to read a failed deployment and how to roll back

Verified by a partner or a colleague outside the team completing a deployment from the docs with no help

Published where partners already look for developer documentation, not in an internal-only space
